assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a polished cozy mobile arcade game thumbnail, landscape 4:3 composition, no lettering or UI. Reference image is character identity reference ONLY: Pongi is this cute warm brown OTTER, round ears, cream muzzle and belly, large glossy black eyes, pink coral starfish hair clip, brown tapered tail; keep this identity, remove fishing rod. Pongi at bottom center holds a long wooden plank horizontally with both paws like a breakout paddle. Above him a white pearl ball bounces toward rows of chunky pastel sea-glass bricks in mint, butter yellow, peach and lavender; a cute blue-gray shark rushes down from upper side and two small torpedoes fire upward. Shallow turquoise sea background, soft foam, subtly sunlit, friendly adventure, painterly cartoon game illustration matching reference polished shading and dark warm outlines. Clear readable silhouette even in small arcade card, uncluttered, central subjects safe for cropping to 4:3 or square. No text, numbers, interface, watermarks, collage panels.

assets.anchor: Computed from the widest opaque plank rows in each frame; plank remains fixed while tail moves.
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D transparent PNG SPRITE SHEET for Phaser breakout game, EXACT 2 columns x 2 rows equal square cells, four frames reading left to right then next row, square 1024x1024 sheet. TRUE transparent background, no checkerboard, labels, borders or environment. Reference is character identity only: Pongi cute brown OTTER, round ears, cream muzzle, starfish hair clip, brown tapered tail, no fishing rod, no clothes. TOP DOWN overhead orthographic camera. Pongi is standing facing NORTH / TOP of each cell, viewed from above and slightly behind so round head, ears, starfish and body/tail visible, not front-facing portrait. Both paws hold the same wide straight wooden plank horizontally in front of him toward TOP of cell. The plank is wide, about 84% of cell width at y=26% of EACH cell, otter centered below plank, tail extends downward ending y=88%. Whole figure within cell. Four coherent gentle idle animation frames: tiny tail swish and paw/ear settling; plank perfectly fixed identical pixel length, center and height in all frames, head center fixed, scale consistent, no full-body bobbing, no duplicates of characters per cell. Cartoon linework, warm brown fur and cream cheek accents matching reference, smooth painted finish, game sprite readability at 104px wide. Alpha surrounds each entire frame.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D cute SHARK charge animation spritesheet, TRUE transparent PNG, exactly 2 columns x 2 rows equal square cells, four frames in reading order, square 1024x1024 canvas. Single blue-gray shark in each cell from STRICT TOP DOWN ORTHOGRAPHIC camera. Every shark head points DOWN toward bottom of screen, tail points UP, symmetrical pectoral fins spread left/right. Each shark fully contained within cell from y=8% tail to y=92% rounded nose, body centered at x=50%, same head center y=75%, same size and alignment across all four cells. Frames animate lateral tail and body flex left, middle, right, middle with stable head and smooth loop. Cute friendly but determined, navy outline, blue-gray back with lighter highlights, small dorsal fin, readable silhouette. Cozy polished cartoon sea-game art, not pixel art, no front view, no side view, no waves, no motion lines, no shadows on ground, no text, numbers, borders or checkerboard. Transparent gutters around each frame. This is a GAME sheet, not an illustration collage.

Use case: stylized-concept. One isolated arcade power-up icon for a cozy sea-themed breakout game. TRUE transparent PNG, square 1024 canvas.
